blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of remote sensing images remains challenging due to the limited high-frequency information in a single low-resolution (LR) observation. While multi-frame SR can exploit complementary sub-pixel information, existing approaches often require real multi-frame training sequences and repeated feature encoding, increasing data acquisition demands and computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose SPS-GS (Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splatting), an encode-once framework that learns from multi-phase LR observations synthesized from individual high-resolution images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) exploits shift-dependent aliasing through Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation, enabling multi-frame information to be integrated before a single deep encoding pass. Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian centers and colors using multi-observation back-projection to promote observation consistency. The refined Gaussians support continuous rendering at arbitrary scales. Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales. The code will be publicly released.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing images provide essential visual information for Earth observation, environmental monitoring, and geographic analysis [ 8 , 49 , 46 , 48 , 35 , 17 ] . However, their spatial resolution is constrained by imaging sensors and acquisition conditions, while downstream applications often require imagery at different spatial scales. Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) addresses this demand by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) images at flexible magnification factors from low-resolution (LR) observations [ 16 , 32 , 57 , 55 , 47 ] . Despite recent advances, recovering fine structures remains challenging because LR sampling discards high-frequency information. With only a single LR observation, reconstruction is inherently underconstrained and relies heavily on learned image priors.
blocks.zh: 遥感图像为地球观测、环境监测和地理分析提供了重要的视觉信息[8、49、46、48、35、17]。 然而,它们的空间分辨率受到成像传感器和获取条件的限制,而下游应用往往需要不同空间尺度的图像. 任意的超分辨率(ASSR)通过从低分辨率(LR)观测中以灵活的放大系数重建高分辨率(HR)图像来满足这一需求[16,32,57,55,47]. 尽管最近取得了进展,但恢复精细结构仍然具有挑战性,因为LR取样会丢弃高频信息。 由于只有单一的LR观测,重建本身就受到不足的制约,并且严重依赖学到的图像前身.

blocks.en:
Existing ASSR methods employ implicit neural representations (INRs) [ 7 , 31 , 4 , 25 ] or 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS) [ 22 , 5 , 40 , 14 ] for continuous reconstruction from a single LR observation ( Fig. 1 (a)), but remain limited by the insufficient high-frequency information in a single LR observation.
Alternatively, multi-frame SR exploits complementary observations of the same scene [ 11 , 3 , 26 ] ,
yet often requires repeated feature encoding followed by alignment and fusion, introducing additional computational overhead ( Fig. 1 (b)).
These limitations motivate an efficient framework that exploits complementary multi-frame information through a single deep encoding pass.
blocks.zh:
现有的ASSR方法采用了隐含神经表达法(INRs)[7,31,4,25]或2D高斯电镀法(2DGS)[22,5,40,14],用于从单一LR观测(图1(a))中持续重建,但仍受到单个LR观测中高频信息不足的限制.
或者,多框架的SR利用对同一场景的补充观测[11、3、26],
但往往需要反复进行特征编码,然后进行对齐和聚变,引入额外的计算间接费用(图1(b))。
这些限制促使形成一个有效的框架,通过一个单一的深层编码通道利用互补的多框架信息。

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that complementary sub-pixel sampling information can be aggregated before deep feature encoding, allowing multiple LR observations to share a single encoding pass.
This motivates three key designs. (i) Single-source, encode-once reconstruction. Multiple complementary LR observations are synthesized from a single HR image through sub-pixel-shifted sampling during training, eliminating the need for real multi-frame training sequences. At inference, multiple LR observations are fused before a single deep encoding pass, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (c). (ii) Phase-coherent information recovery. Sub-pixel shifts introduce distinct phase modulations to aliased frequency components, whose complementary information may be suppressed by phase-agnostic fusion, motivating phase-aware aggregation. (iii) Observation-consistent Gaussian reconstruction. Feature fusion alone does not ensure consistency with the observed LR frames. The Gaussian representation is therefore refined using multi-observation reconstruction errors to promote observation consistency while supporting continuous rendering at arbitrary scales.
blocks.zh:
我们的关键洞察力是,互补的子像素采样信息可以在深度特征编码之前进行汇总,允许多个LR观测共享一个单一编码通道.
这激励了三种关键设计. (i) 单一来源、编码即刻重建。 多个互补的LR观测从单一的HR图像中通过训练期间的子像素转移取样合成,从而不再需要真正的多帧训练序列. 如图1(c)所示,推断出,多个LR观测值在单一深度编码通道之前就被熔化。 (二)相协调的信息回收. 子像素转动向别名频率元件引入不同的相位调制,其补充信息可能通过相位不可知聚变来压制,激发相位知聚变. (三)观测一致的高斯重建. 单是特性聚变并不能保证与观测到的LR框架的一致性. 因此,高斯代表法被用多观测重建错误加以改进,以促进观测一致性,同时支持任意尺度的持续渲染.

blocks.en:
Motivated by these insights, we propose SPS-GS ( S ub- P ixel- S hifted G aussian S platting), an encode-once framework for arbitrary-scale remote sensing image super-resolution based on 2D Gaussian splatting.
Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) combines Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation to exploit complementary aliasing information before a single deep encoding pass.
Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian colors and centers using multi-observation back-projection to promote consistency with the observed LR frames.
The resulting Gaussian representation supports efficient rendering at arbitrary scales.
Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales.
blocks.zh:
基于这些见解,我们提出SPS-GS(Sub-Pixel-S hifted Gausian S platting),这是基于2D高斯电镀的任意尺度遥感图像超分辨率的编码-once框架.
具体地说,相协调异调(PCAD)结合了傅里叶基对调,相感余聚变,和最小平方别名估计,在一次深编码通过前利用互补异名信息.
然后,高斯投影对齐(GPA)利用多观测后置投影来反复改进高斯的颜色和中心,以促进与观测到的LR框架的一致性.
由此产生的高斯代表支持在任意的尺度上高效的渲染。
对五个遥感数据集进行的广泛实验显示,对照单一图像和多框架的SR基线,进行了强有力的重建,同时在共同尺度上保持了竞争性推论效率。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose SPS-GS, an encode-once framework for ASSR that integrates complementary sub-pixel-shifted LR observations into a unified 2D Gaussian representation, enabling single-source synthetic training and multi-frame reconstruction with a single deep encoding pass. • We develop Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) to exploit shift-dependent aliasing information through Fourier alignment, phase-aware fusion, and least-squares estimation before deep encoding. • We introduce Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA), which iteratively refines Gaussian colors and centers through multi-observation back-projection to promote consistency with the observed LR frames while supporting arbitrary-scale rendering. • Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets validate the effectiveness and efficiency of SPS-GS across both seen and unseen super-resolution scales.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出SPS-GS,这是ASSR的编码操作框架,将互补的子像素变换的LR观测结果整合到统一的2D高斯代表器中,使单源合成培训和多帧重建能够有一个单一的深编码通道. —— 我们开发了相协调异调(PCAD),通过Fourier对齐、相感聚和深度编码前的最小方位估计,利用依赖转向的别名信息。 我们引入高斯投影对齐(GPA),它通过多观测反投影,迭代地精炼高斯的颜色和中心,促进与观测到的LR帧的一致性,同时支持任意尺度渲染. • 5个遥感数据集的广泛实验验证了卫生和植物检疫总系统在可见和看不见的超分辨率尺度上的效力和效率。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Remote Sensing Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.1 遥感超级分辨率

blocks.en:
Remote sensing SR has evolved from CNNs [ 32 ] to transformers [ 57 ] , diffusion models [ 56 ] , and state space models [ 55 ] , mainly targeting fixed scales.
ASSR enables flexible reconstruction through scale-conditioned filters [ 23 ] and implicit functions [ 7 ] , further advanced by texture modeling [ 31 ] , attention [ 4 ] , neural operators [ 51 ] , latent modulation [ 20 ] , neural heat fields [ 2 ] , and hierarchical encoding [ 25 ] .
Remote sensing ASSR explores implicit-space interaction [ 6 ] , scale awareness [ 53 ] , neural-operator diffusion [ 59 ] , and Gaussian reconstruction [ 65 , 36 ] .
Unlike these predominantly single-image methods, SPS-GS exploits complementary sub-pixel-shifted observations through pre-encoding fusion for arbitrary-scale reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
遥感SR从CNNs[32]演化为变压器[57],扩散模型[56],状态空间模型[55],主要瞄准固定尺度.
ASSR通过标定尺寸的滤波器[23]和暗含的功能[7],通过纹理模型[31],注意[4],神经操作器[51],潜在调制[20],神经热场[2],分级编码[25]进一步推进了灵活重建.
遥感ASSR探索隐含空间交互[6],规模意识[53],神经-操作器传播[59],高斯重建[65,36].
与这些以单像方法为主的方法不同,SPS-GS通过预编码聚变利用互补的子像素转换观测,进行任意规模重建.

blocks.en: 2.2 2D Gaussian Splatting for Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.2 2D 用于超解析的高斯滑板

blocks.en:
Gaussian splatting represents visual content using anisotropic Gaussian primitives and efficient rasterization [ 28 ] .
GaussianImage [ 63 ] , Image-GS [ 64 ] , and LIG [ 66 ] optimize Gaussian primitives for image representation and compression.
For ASSR, feed-forward networks instead predict Gaussian representations.
GaussianSR [ 22 ] decodes rendered Gaussian features into colors, while GSASR [ 5 ] predicts image-adaptive Gaussians for direct arbitrary-scale rendering.
ContinuousSR [ 40 ] employs pixel-wise Gaussians with a learned covariance dictionary for efficient reconstruction.
TADSR [ 65 ] and FlowGS [ 36 ] extend Gaussian-based SR to remote sensing imagery.
Unlike these predominantly single-image methods, SPS-GS combines feed-forward Gaussian prediction with multi-observation refinement, where GPA iteratively updates Gaussian centers and colors using LR reconstruction errors to promote observation consistency.
blocks.zh:
高斯滑板表示视觉内容,使用异构高斯原始和高效的光栅化[28].
Gaussian Image [63],Image-GS [64],以及LIG [66] 优化高斯原始人进行图像表现和压缩.
对ASSR来说,feed-forward网络则预测高斯的表示.
GaussianSR [22] 解码使Gaussian特征变为颜色,而GSASR [5] 预测图像适应的Gaussians用于直接任意的刻度渲染.
SustainSR [40] 使用像素型的高斯人,并配有博学的共变词典来高效重建.
TADSR [65]和FlowGS [36]将基于高斯的SR扩展至遥感图像.
与这些以单一图像为主的方法不同,SPS-GS结合了向导的高斯预测和多观测改进,GPA在其中反复更新高斯中心及颜色,使用LR重建错误来提升观测一致性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Multi-Frame Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.3 多纤维超分辨率

blocks.en:
Classical multi-frame SR exploits complementary sub-pixel samples through generalized sampling theory [ 39 ] and frequency-domain reconstruction [ 44 ] , followed by iterative back-projection [ 24 ] and joint registration and reconstruction [ 18 ] .
These principles have been applied to satellite imaging systems, including SPOT-5 [ 30 ] and SkySat [ 29 ] .
Deep multi-frame SR has advanced through PROBA-V reconstruction [ 11 , 1 , 45 ] , multi-temporal and cross-sensor fusion [ 9 , 43 , 41 ] , and satellite video SR [ 58 , 37 , 38 ] .
Related burst SR methods exploit frame alignment and feature fusion [ 3 , 52 , 15 , 12 , 26 ] .
Meanwhile, deep back-projection networks [ 19 , 61 ] and diffusion-based restoration [ 27 ] incorporate observation-driven reconstruction.
Building on these principles, SPS-GS integrates shift-dependent aliasing information before a single deep encoding pass and refines Gaussian parameters through multi-observation back-projection.
blocks.zh:
经典多帧SR通过通用采样理论[39]和频率域重建[44]利用互补的子像素样本,然后进行迭代回投影[24]和联合登记和重建[18].
这些原则适用于卫星成像系统,包括SPOT-5[30]和SkySat[29]。
深度多帧SR通过PROBA-V重建[11,1,45],多时和跨传感器聚变[9,43,41],卫星视频SR[58,37,38]推进.
相关爆破的SR方法利用帧对齐和特征聚变[3,52,15,12,26].
同时,深反投影网[19,61]和推广式恢复[27]包括观察驱动的重建。
在这些原则的基础上,SPS-GS在单一深度编码通过之前整合了依赖转向的别名信息,并通过多观测反投影来完善高斯参数.

blocks.en: We evaluate on AID [ 54 ] , UCMerced [ 60 ] , WHU-RS19 [ 10 ] , RSSCN7 [ 67 ] , and NWPU-RESISC45 [ 8 ] , using fixed train/test splits with 2,000, 420, 102, 280, and 3,150 test images, respectively. For each test image, we synthesize K = 8 K{=}8 LR observations using Eq. 2 with a fixed random seed. Single-image baselines use only the reference frame y 0 y_{0} , whereas all multi-frame methods receive the same K K LR observations. Additional evaluations on three real-world multi-frame datasets are presented in Sec. 5.3 . We report PSNR, SSIM [ 50 ] , LPIPS [ 62 ] , DISTS [ 13 ] , and FID [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用2000、420、102、280和3 150的试验图像对AID [54]、UCMerced [60]、WHU-RS19 [10]、RSSCN7 [67]和NWPU-RESISC45 [8]进行评估。 对于每个测试图像,我们用Eq. 2合成K = 8 K{=}8 LR的观测结果,有一个固定的随机种子. 单一图像基线只使用参考框架y 0 y_{0},而所有多框架方法都得到相同的 K K LR 观测。 关于三个现实世界的多框架数据集的其他评价见Sec。 5.3 (中文(简体) ). 我们报告PSNR、SSIM[50]、LPIPS[62]、DISTS[13]和FID[21]。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports GPU busy time measured using an NVIDIA RTX 4090. By combining single-pass encoding with Gaussian rasterization, SPS-GS achieves runtime comparable to ContinuousSR at × 4 \times 4 (75.5 vs . 80.4 ms), while using substantially less memory (1.40 vs . 3.44 GiB at × 2 \times 2 ). Although BurstM is slightly faster at × 4 \times 4 , it is approximately twice as slow at × 8 \times 8 and × 16 \times 16 ; BIPNet, LIIF, and GSASR also incur higher inference costs across the evaluated scales. While ContinuousSR is faster at larger scales, it uses only a single LR observation, whereas SPS-GS exploits K = 8 K{=}8 frames. By combining input-dependent encoding with efficient Gaussian rendering, SPS-GS achieves a favorable balance between multi-frame reconstruction quality and inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了使用NVIDIA RTX 4090测量的GPU繁忙时间. 通过将单通道编码与高斯光栅化相结合,SPS-GS在X 4\times 4(75.5 vs. 80.4 ms)上实现了可与连续SR相比的运行时间,同时使用内存少得多(1.40 vs. 3.44 GiB at × 2\times 2). 虽然BurstM在×4 \time 4 时稍快,但在×8 \time 8 和 × 16 \time 16 时速度大约是两倍;BIPNet、LIIF和GSASR在评价的尺度上还产生较高的推论费用。 虽然连续SR在更大的尺度上更快,但它只使用单一的LR观测,而SPS-GS则利用K=8K{=}8帧. 通过将输入依赖编码与高效的高斯渲染相结合,SPS-GS在多帧重建质量和推论效率之间实现了有利的平衡.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , single-image methods often produce blurred or distorted fine structures, such as lane markings, checkerboard patterns, and parking-lot hatching. BurstM and BIPNet recover additional details but may still exhibit structural artifacts. In contrast, SPS-GS better preserves the continuity of lane markings, the regularity of repetitive patterns, and the geometric structure of objects in these challenging examples. Additional visual comparisons, including randomly selected samples, are provided in the Appendix .

blocks.en: We further evaluate on three real-world multi-frame datasets: PROBA-V [ 34 ] ( × 3 \times 3 ), WorldStrat [ 9 ] ( × 4 \times 4 ), and RealBSR-RGB [ 52 ] ( × 4 \times 4 ). At each dataset’s native scale, we use the original LR observations, while other scales are evaluated using bicubic-downsampled real HR frames, preserving inter-frame variations with synthetic degradations. Each method receives the same K = 8 K{=}8 LR frames. All methods are trained from scratch on PROBA-V and WorldStrat and fine-tuned from their AID weights on RealBSR-RGB. For SPS-GS, inter-frame shifts are estimated via phase correlation (details in the Appendix ). Table 4 shows that SPS-GS achieves the highest PSNR on RealBSR-RGB across all evaluated scales, outperforming the strongest baselines by up to 0.46 dB. On PROBA-V, it performs best at × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 and remains competitive at higher scales. On WorldStrat, it achieves the highest cPSNR at × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , and × 8 \times 8 , while remaining competitive at × 16 \times 16 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价三个现实世界的多框架数据集: PROBA-V [34] (x 3\time 3 ), WorldStrat [9] (x 4\time 4 ),和 RealBSR-RGB [52] (x 4\time 4 ). 在每一个数据集的原生尺度上,我们使用最初的LR观测结果,而其他尺度则使用双立方下取样真实的HR帧来评估,用合成降解来保存帧间的变化. 每种方法都得到相同的K = 8 K{=}8 LR框架. 所有方法都从头到尾接受关于PROBA-V和WorldStrat的培训,并根据它们在RealBSR-RGB上的AID权重进行微调. 就卫生和植物检疫总公司而言,通过相间关联性对机体间变化作出估计(详见附录)。 表4显示,卫生和植物检疫总公司在所有评价尺度上都实现了RealBSR-RGB上最高的PSNR,比最强基线高0.46分贝。 在PROBA-V上,它的表现最好在×2\time 2和×4\time 4上,并且在更高的尺度上保持竞争力. 在WorldStrat上,它实现了最高的CPSNR,以×2\time2,×4\time4和×8\time8的成绩,同时保持16\time16的竞争力.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 5 , removing both PCAD and GPA reduces SPS-GS to a single-image Gaussian SR baseline, with an average PSNR of 30.08 dB. Introducing PCAD or GPA individually improves PSNR by up to 4.03 and 3.85 dB, respectively. Combining both components further improves average PSNR by 0.45 dB over PCAD alone and 0.74 dB over GPA alone, achieving 33.17 dB. These results demonstrate the complementary benefits of phase-aware information aggregation and observation-guided Gaussian refinement. Similar improvements are observed in LPIPS and DISTS ( Appendix ).

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that Fourier-aligned residuals improve PSNR by up to 0.43 dB with GPA. The phase-aware branch ψ \psi provides modest gains, while shift encoding ϕ \phi yields improvements of up to 0.46 dB, highlighting the importance of shift-dependent aliasing ( Eq. 4 ). LS estimation provides additional gains of up to 0.05 dB, with negligible changes at × 2 \times 2 . Replacing Fourier alignment with bilinear interpolation reduces PSNR by up to 0.14 dB, while attention pooling instead of summation decreases PSNR by up to 0.06 dB.

blocks.en: Table 5 examines the effect of GPA iterations. Increasing T T from 0 (PCAD only) to 3, 5, and 7 progressively improves average PSNR from 32.72 to 32.95, 33.08, and 33.17 dB, respectively, with diminishing returns. Removing the Haar sub-bands or disabling Gaussian center updates reduces average PSNR by 0.05 and 0.06 dB, respectively, demonstrating the benefits of high-frequency error cues and spatial refinement. Additional module variants and hyperparameter analyses are provided in the Appendix .

All variants achieve comparable reconstruction accuracy, with average PSNR ranging from 33.17 to 33.21 dB. Specifically, 2DGS achieves approximately 7.0 × 7.0\times and 10.1 × 10.1\times faster inference than LIIF and LTE, respectively, with only a marginal PSNR difference of at most 0.04 dB on average.

blocks.en: Figure 4 analyzes the factors contributing to reconstruction gains. Increasing the number of LR frames to 4, 8, and 16 yields PSNR gains of 3.0, 4.8, and 5.3 dB at × 2 \times 2 , respectively ( Fig. 4 a), while additional GPA iterations provide diminishing but consistent improvements ( Fig. 4 b). Across AID classes, the gain of SPS-GS over ContinuousSR at × 2 \times 2 ranges from 3.2 dB for smooth desert scenes to 5.7 dB for texture-rich school scenes ( Fig. 4 c), suggesting greater benefits in recovering fine structures. Moreover, SPS-GS outperforms competing methods across all 30 AID classes at × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 . Relative to Fourier-based alignment, bilinear and bicubic interpolation exhibit normalized deviations of 144% and 60%, respectively ( Fig. 4 d).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented SPS-GS, an encode-once framework for remote sensing ASSR that learns from sub-pixel-shifted LR observations synthesized from individual HR images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. At inference, PCAD aggregates complementary aliasing information from multiple LR observations before a single deep encoding pass, while GPA iteratively refines Gaussian colors and centers through multi-frame back-projection to promote observation consistency. Experiments on five remote sensing benchmarks and three real-world multi-frame datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction accuracy across seen and unseen scales, with competitive inference efficiency. Future work will address radiometric variations, cloud interference, and parallax in real-world observations.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SPS-GS,这是一个遥感ASSR的编码即时框架,它从从个别人力资源图像合成的子像素转换的LR观测中学习,而不需要真正的多框架训练序列。 在推论中,PCAD通过多帧反投影法,将多个LR观测结果中的信息进行补充化拼凑,在单一深度编码通过之前,GPA通过多帧反投影法,迭代完善高斯的颜色和中心,促进观测一致性. 关于五个遥感基准和三个现实世界的多帧数据集的实验表明,在可见和看不见的尺度上,重建精度很高,具有竞争性的推论效率。 今后的工作将涉及辐射测量变化、云干扰和现实世界观测中的参数。
